curationProtocol:
- source of truth for dishes: the 166 bundled recipe titles in apps/ios/Resources/data.json
  (recipes 1-25 are the hand-curated starter set with meaningful ingredient lists; 26-166 are
  imported from a BBC GoodFood scrape whose ingredient arrays are known-unreliable per the
  recipe-import-fidelity audit, so plausibility judgments rest on titles and dish identity).
- a class is exact when one bundled recipe is a plausible rendering of the photographed dish;
  coarse when >= 2 bundled recipes are interchangeable renderings of that one dish;
  ambiguous when plausible candidates exist but are non-equivalent (suggesting one specific
  recipe would be over-specific); unsupported when no bundled recipe could be offered without
  misleading the user. nearMiss names the closest rejected candidates and why they were rejected.
- uniqueness: exact/coarse recipes serve exactly one class; ambiguous candidates must not
  overlap any exact/coarse answer; candidate sets may be shared when two classes name the
  same dish family (hamburger / cheeseburger).

nearDuplicate.reason: chosen during development by inspecting dev-pool dHash distribution; dev images within threshold of any official-test image are excluded from dev selection so thresholds never touch test-lookalike data

abstention.policy: suggest one specific recipe only when the predicted class maps to exactly one recipe (status=exact) and top1 probability >= tau
abstention.tauSource: tau is chosen on dev_manifest.json predictions as the smallest tau whose suggestion precision reaches the target; the chosen value is recorded in results/dev-threshold.json and never tuned on test data
